command.name: Calculated Assault
verbatim: Each Round: 20% chance to reduce the Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) by -12% of the Enemy with the highest Strength for 2 rounds(s).
Rounds 2, 4, 7, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to the Enemy with the least troops (Damage Rate: +100%).

At 6+ Stars: Rounds 3, 5, 8, 10: Deal Fire Damage to all Enemies that deal Physical Damage (excluding Basic Attacks) (Damage Rate: +40%). This damage is increased by 1.5x against targets afflicted with Burn (Damage Rate: +60%).

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Resilient Bond
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Grant yourself and 1 other Ally within adjacency 1 stack of Resilient Bond. At the start of each round, if the target Ally retreated in the previous round, grant yourself 1 stack of Resilient Bond. Each stack of Resilient Bond reduces the target's Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) by -6% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Insightful Allies
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Instinct by +10% (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Emerald Inferno
habits.verbatim: Calculated Assault gains: Rounds 3, 5, 8, 10: Deal Fire Damage to all Enemies that deal Physical Damage (excluding Basic Attacks) (Damage Rate: +40%). This damage is increased by 1.5x against targets afflicted with Burn (Damage Rate: +60%).

habits.name: Quick-Witted
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Intelligence and Initiative by +16% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Unyielding Grasp
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 10% chance to Stagger 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes Warriors) for 3 round(s).
